Kept lowest are 0-view places with one counted source each, passing on Parks Victoria pages. Spots keep 0 views because most have no own Wikipedia article.
notes: Kept 50 = 47 spots + 3 destination-named candidates (Wilsons Promontory National Park, Croajingolong National Park, Gippsland Lakes) which became destinations. Lowest-view kept places score 0; every stronger left-out place has a concrete What-qualifies reason.
